notes.title: 冬促开启&新活动预告
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/cad70404dc1412e504ed29e03142478a5c740ebf.jpg[/img]
[h3]温暖人心的“Steam冬季特卖”正式开启啦~！我们为大家带来了跨越年度的全品优惠以及新形式的活动预告，快来看看吧——[/h3]


[h2]❄️ LSP冬季特卖[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/d3232c503db62198b6320a4694b01336085df636.png[/img]
[b]横跨圣诞与新年的惊爆特价！[/b]
12月20日-1月3日期间，购买LSP恋爱游戏系列作品可以享受特别价格。发售后获得“特别好评(50,94%)”的青春校园恋爱散文诗《大鹏 - The Roc》推出了20%折扣的新历史低价，仅需19.2元即可入手！
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/4ab85a407ffc4117c6c4a596c1adc2832dea1066.png[/img]

[h2]⛄ 限时捆绑包[/h2]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44087593/ee52910706db5efaf9692e977cbb67893944d127.jpg[/img]
百合之花暗处绽放，“LSP Dark Yuri Bundle”限时推出，为您带来两部具有黑暗风格与百合情节的作品。冬季促销期间，把《彷徨之街》和《无梦少女》集齐一套，可以享受-17%的优惠折扣，叠加促销仅需45元即可入手2个今年发售的新作。

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48575/LSP_Dark_Yuri_Bundle/

❙　前往LSP乐透抽奖：[url=https://www.lspsp.me/lottery]https://www.lspsp.me/lottery[/url]

[h2]Girls high school students traveling through the Three Kingdoms? Hey hey Cao Thief, don't get into their wrong minds! [/h2]

The Coraboration between Tricolour Lovestory and the new comming Roguelike Cardgame RPG Fantasy of Caocao 2  has begun! We've prepared corabo character skins and giveaways for players who love both games, so let's find out what's in store for you-!

[h3]🎈Activity 1: Get Free Skin🎈[/h3]

All Steam users who have "Tricolor Lovestory“ in their lib can receive a free girls' high school themed character skin redemption code for the game's debut characters "Cai Wenji" and "Xiao Qiao" dressed in No.12 High School Uniform. This event is permanent, and you don't have to buy the linked game to get it!!

[h3]🎈Activity 2: Game Key Luckydraw🎈[/h3]

Free benefit, AGAIN! Users who have "Tricolour Lovestory" can participate in the "Fantasy of Caocao 2" game key code welfare giveaway, a total of 100 copies will be given out yo! 

[b][>>[url=https://www.lspsp.me/lottery]Participate in the two activities above[/url]<<][/b]
（! Exclusive for Mainland China users, if you have a China phone number, you can also participate）

[hr][/hr]
[h3]About Fantasy of Caocao2 [/h3]
Playing cards isn't as much fun as a man's wife - the brutal king Caocao's reincarnation of hegemony.

notes.content:

 [url=https://item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=739578911423][h3]🛒Go to Store[/h3][/url]

[i][u][b]（ Available exclusively for mainland China ）[/b][/u][/i]

The LoveStoryProject team and HL-Galgame want to express our heartfelt thanks to all of you. We believe that this event will pave the way for new horizons in the series' future.

notes.title: Hotfix about missing sasavedata
notes.content:
Due to certain file collision in the krkr emgine, some of you have experienced data loss after the update, we sincerely apologize and have fixed the problem.

Meanwhile, the gamers who experienced data loss will be properly compensated. 

This update may cause data loss, please turn off Steam Cloud and backup your savedata first before you update. 

Gamers who experienced data loss in the previous update can send a email to miiro726@yamayuri.vip, we'll offer you a official savedata and try to solve your other problems. 

We, the Operations of Tricolour Lovestory, apologize again for the inconvenience. We'll take this incident as a sign and try to avoid this kind of problem in the future. 

Thank all of you for your support, have a good day and game on.

tags.bug: Due to certain file collision in the krkr emgine, some of you have experienced data loss after the update, we sincerely apologize and have fixed the problem.

notes.title: Tricolour△Lovestory#Coloured Episodes–Orange Side-#Update
notes.content:
With the update of Coloured Episodes –Orange Side-（Daisy side）, all the content is complete for the main story.

Overall:
Coloured Episodes Chapter 5-The only colour I need is updated. 
You can start at the 4th Chapter and choose Daisy, if you have, you can start Chapter 5 in Bookmark

More convenient: 
* You don't need to go through Rough Episodes to unlock Extra.
* To prevent spoil, you can only check gallery when you've played both Sides.

Bug fixes: 
* Fixed the missing voices in Chapter 5 and Chapter-Zero
* Fixed the bug that causes glitch in Voice Bookmark

OST to come: 
We'll add 2 more songs from Coloured Episodes –Orange Side-(GameSize)

We're about reach the climaxof update, stay tuned, stay hydrated, and as always, have a good day and game on!
